# TazUO Holiday Edition - music map
#
# Which music plays where, when the server says it has none.
#
# Converted from the region data of the 1998 Ultima Online Demo server
# (uogolddemo/regions.txt). Values are Origin's, unchanged - one track per
# area, exactly as authored. Nothing here is invented.
#
# Rectangles are applied largest first, so the SMALLEST area covering a spot
# wins. That is the rule the 1998 server used (CBlockManager, 0x0042FD01).
#
# tracks : one or more music indices, comma separated. Indices are the
#          canonical 0-48 set; which FILE each one plays is decided by the
#          Config.txt of whichever music era is selected. To mute or swap a
#          track, edit that Config.txt - not this file.
#
# map    : 0 = Felucca, 1 = Trammel (a copy of Felucca, so it shares the data)
#
